column2: Outflanking and disc conversion identify a particular game, not the generic board-games field. Reversi was included in the synonym search; no pinned equivalent was found.
The thirty-square Egyptian game and its funerary role delimit Senet independently from board games in general.
The twenty-square Near Eastern-derived game is distinct from Senet and its Egyptian visual adaptation is a subject-specific takeaway.
A named athlete and the adoption of his jumping technique are distinct from sports psychology. Basketball and Fosbury synonyms were checked.
A named inventor and a documented design brief differ from basketball as a sport; the original constraints supply a learning takeaway.
Ordinary castling rights and blocking conditions are distinct from the pinned Chess960 starting-square adaptation.
No legal moves while not in check defines stalemate; this is not checkmate or generic chess.
Impossibility of any future legal mate differs from stalemate's present legal-move test and from move-count draws.
A player's deliberate touch imposes a conduct constraint, separate from piece movement or legal-position rules.

The claimable three-occurrence procedure is a separate FIDE rule from automatic fivefold repetition. Revise the takeaway to emphasize claiming and timing: the current identical-position wording repeats the pinned fivefold card's central explanation.
Choosing a nonqueen promotion is a well-delimited strategic rule option, not a renamed promotion example.
Liberties are the game's adjacent-empty-point mechanism, narrower than the broad named Go identity even though its earlier card uses liberties.
Two-eye survival is a distinct local life mechanism, contrasted with seki's shared-liberty survival.
Immediate recapture prohibition is narrower than whole-game situational superko; keep the rule variant explicit.
Mutual survival by shared liberties differs from an independently alive two-eyed group.
First-move compensation is a separate scoring parameter; the BGA amount must remain jurisdiction/ruleset-specific.
Whole-game player-relative repetition prohibition differs from the immediate ko rule; the captured BGA passage explicitly states the player condition.
Area versus territory scoring changes how occupied points and prisoners enter a result; a specific rule comparison, not another broad Go card.
Transferable ownership of the redoubling option differs from basic backgammon movement and race conditions.
A double-value win before the loser bears off is a defined scoring condition, distinct from the game or doubling cube.
Home-board eligibility and oversized-roll conditions define the finishing phase independently from ordinary movement.
Mandatory re-entry after a hit is a separate priority rule. The broad backgammon card mentions it but does not own every specific rule.
An optional rule suppressing undoubled bonus wins is distinct from both gammon and doubling-cube ownership.
Compulsory passing when no outflank exists is a bounded Othello rule, distinct from the named game's general disc-conversion mechanism.
The checking-player loss condition distinguishes this shogi repetition rule from ordinary repetition and the named game. Avoid merely repeating the broad Shogi control's angle.
Impasse and material counting address advanced kings without feasible mate; distinguish professional and amateur procedures.
Comparing players holding identical deals defines a bridge competition format, not the finesse technique or the general game.
Vulnerability is a scoring state affecting risk, distinct from bidding a contract or executing a finesse.
The exposed partnership hand and declarer's control define a particular bridge role, not a synonym for the game.
Offside offence requires involvement in play, not merely an offside position; a rule facet separate from football's outcome/scoring control.
Spin-related lateral force is a baseball application of aerodynamics, with the simplified NASA assumptions retained.
Air-density dependence is separately delimited from spin-induced curvature itself; retain other-factors-equal qualification.
Seam-dependent, changing aerodynamic force differs from steady spin-induced curveball force.
A vibration-node sweet spot differs from maximum rebound and from the support-dependent center of percussion.
Cancellation of rotational and translational recoil at a specified support differs from the vibration node.
An effective-mass energy-transfer point differs from both the percussion point and low-vibration sweet spot.
Wake-mediated drag reduction is a specific cycling application of aerodynamics, not the broad physical field.
Work on the ice changes stone travel without contact; a separate curling technique with uncertain detailed mechanism retained.
Proportional shortening is the inverse rhythmic transformation to the pinned augmentation identity, not its alias.
Reversing one melody's order differs from reversing interval directions and from a two-line crab-canon form.
Leap approach and step departure delimit a nonchord-tone type independently from chord or suspension.
A sustained note changing harmonic status differs from a prepared suspension with stepwise resolution.
Preparation, accented dissonance and downward step resolution define a specific nonchord-tone mechanism.
Progressively extending repeated patterns differs from proportionally lengthening each note and from minimalism in general.
Changing the alignment of repeated patterns is a compositional process, separate from the particular Reich works illustrating it.
Modified subject intervals answering at the dominant define a bounded fugue procedure, not all fugue imitation.
Recurring subject-accompanying counterpoint differs from the subject and from an independently changing accompaniment.
Perceived high/low ordering is a sound dimension, not musical tone as an entire sound or concert pitch as a tuning reference. It is distinct from batch 004's pitch material.
Deviation of string modal frequencies from harmonic multiples differs from the string-harmonic playing technique.
Nonlinear bow excitation locking motion to harmonic ratios is a mechanism distinct from passive string inharmonicity.
Reich's named 1972 work uses discrete rotations; it is distinct from gradual Piano Phase and Music for 18 Musicians.
The named twelve-note gradual phasing work differs from Clapping Music's discrete rotations and the general process.
Glass's named work demonstrates additive organization through shortened repetitions; not an alias of additive minimalism.
A named opera and specified scene's durational process are distinct from the generic minimalism movement.
The specific BWV 847 work supports learning through exposition and episode analysis, separate from fugue in general.
The specific BWV 772 work combines identifiable transformations; it is not the generic two-part invention form.
Barber's specific named work supplies an analyzed suspension example, separate from suspension as a mechanism.
Flattened-supertonic major harmony has a distinct chromatic predominant function, unlike cadential six-four.
Chromatic contrary-semitone approach to the dominant defines the augmented-sixth family, distinct from Neapolitan harmony.
Rhythmic species are a bounded pedagogical system within counterpoint. The pinned broad counterpoint card mentions exercises, but does not identify the full species practice as equivalent.
Perception of a pitch without its fundamental is a distinct psychoacoustic phenomenon, not the whole musical tone.
Widening octaves to compensate for string stiffness is a specific tuning application, distinct from the inharmonicity phenomenon itself.
Difference-frequency interaction identifies a combination tone, not a wolf tone or fundamental tone. Preserve the source's caveat about ear versus instrument nonlinearities.
Small-integer-ratio tuning is an interval-system choice, not an individual interval ratio or the broad acoustics field.
Meantone tempering narrows fifths to improve thirds. Q80157 is personality temperament, a homonym, not a musical parent or equivalent. Use a verified musical target or document missing parent.
The acoustic effective length beyond an open pipe end is a bounded physical correction, not all wind-instrument acoustics.
An approximately closed-open cylinder's next register at the twelfth is a clarinet-specific application, distinct from the instrument identity.
Physical objects modifying piano-string behavior define a preparation technique, separate from the piano and a particular prepared-piano work.
The friction-driven rotating glass-bowl instrument differs from Q51290's free-reed harmonica; the type is legitimately an idea, not an individual named object.
Cage's specific three-movement composition directs attention to ambient sound; a named work with a defensible learning takeaway.
Cage's particular cycle is distinct from prepared piano as a technique; its preparation materials make the work-specific angle concrete.
Fux's specific historical treatise is distinct from species counterpoint as a general practice.
The verbal/visuospatial/executive architecture is a model of temporary processing, not memory generally or a particular reading-span test.
Personally related encoding and later recall advantage delimit a specific memory effect.
Skill memory is distinct from verbal/declarative recall and from muscle adaptation after strength training.
Older learning obstructing new recall has the opposite temporal direction from retroactive interference.
New learning obstructing older recall has the opposite temporal direction from proactive interference.
Post-event misleading information changing memory reports is a mechanism within false-memory phenomena, not a synonym for every false memory or every social memory influence.
The named clinical case separates new declarative learning from practiced-task improvement; distinct from memory as a faculty.
Fifty-percent detection of a stimulus defines an absolute threshold, distinct from sensitivity to differences between stimuli.
Intensity-dependent change detection defines a difference threshold, not an absolute detection threshold.
Reduced response or notice during continuing stimulation differs from evolutionary adaptation Q483921 and from inattentional blindness.
Failure to notice an unexpected stimulus during another task differs from the pinned rapid second-target reporting deficit.
Signal-versus-noise decisions under expectation differ from simple absolute thresholds; do not reduce the theory to a motivation anecdote.
Perceptual completion of missing parts differs from epistemic deduction closure and from smooth-contour continuation.
Grouping smooth continuations is a Gestalt organization rule, distinct from completing a missing shape.
Persistence with a prior problem-solving method is a delimited cognitive mechanism within broad psychological inertia; it is not defined merely as unwillingness to change.
Restricting an object's possible uses is explicitly a subtype of mental set; the source's candle problem supports separate subject matter.
Enjoyment-based motivation defines an internal motivational source, distinct from generic goal-directed motivation or effects of adding rewards.
Task-difficulty-dependent arousal/performance patterns are a specific relationship; avoid a universal inverted-U claim.
Task-capability belief is distinct from motivation's value, reward and desire components.
Central versus peripheral persuasion routes form a specific processing model within social psychology.
Small-then-large request sequencing is a defined compliance technique with bounded experimental support.
The named line-judgment experiments are specific historical studies, not the generic conformity mechanism.
Acceptance-driven conformity differs from relying on a group's perceived information.
Uncertainty-driven reliance on others differs from acceptance-driven conformity.
The named obedience experiments and their conditions are distinct from general conformity or social psychology.
Agreement among independent observers is distinct from repeated-administration stability.
Stability across administrations is distinct from agreement among raters.
Capturing the intended construct differs from measurement consistency or research-setting realism.
Real-world applicability/representativeness is distinct from construct validity. Retain the source's stated sense rather than silently conflating every meaning of ecological validity.
Researcher expectations affecting observation or scoring are distinct from participants' expectations and from a blinding procedure preventing both.
Concealment from participants and investigators defines a study-design method; batch 003's allocation concealment and intention-to-treat remain distinct.
Post-study explanation of concealed purpose is a specific ethical procedure, distinct from the deception that prompts it.
Withholding or misrepresenting purpose under ethical limits is a distinct design practice, not the later debriefing.
Self-presentation-distorted reporting differs from researcher expectancy bias or inaccurate memory.
Difficulty separating closely connected means and side effects is an explicitly named objection to double effect, not the doctrine itself.
Causing versus permitting harm is a distinction independent of intending versus foreseeing it.
Luck in which moral tests one faces differs from consequence luck and from unchosen character traits.
Luck in dispositions and formation differs from luck in external circumstances or consequences.
Good acts beyond duty differ from binding duties whose fulfillment allows discretion.
Flexibility in fulfilling a binding duty differs from the optional goodness of supererogation.
A disputed category of bad but permissible conduct differs from both forbidden acts and good supererogatory acts.
The truth/belief/justification analysis is a proposed definition of knowledge, not an alias for the whole phenomenon of knowing. Frame it as a challenged analysis.
Accidentally true justified belief challenges the analysis's sufficiency; a problem distinct from the proposed analysis.
Excluding false inferential premises is one attempted repair, not a restatement of the Gettier problem or knowledge generally.
A deceptive environment defeating an otherwise accurate belief tests the repair without false inference; a separately meaningful named case.
Counterfactual loss of belief when false differs from safety's robustness of true belief in nearby cases.
Nearby-case avoidance of false belief differs from sensitivity's specific if-false counterfactual.
Jointly accepting individually likely ticket losses creates a specific aggregation paradox, not the lottery game or deductive closure principle.
Individually supported claims plus an expected error in their totality create a different fallibility paradox from the lottery setup.
First-person assertion combined with disbelief has distinctive pragmatic/epistemic tension, not generic inconsistency.
Recognizing an unknown answer generates an inquiry dilemma, distinct from justification and aggregation paradoxes.
Sameness of object versus likeness of properties is a general identity distinction, broader than personal persistence and independent of constitution puzzles.
Identical objects sharing properties is a logical principle, not its converse identity of indiscernibles or merely qualitative similarity.
Sortal-relative sameness is a contested identity theory, not personal identity alone or the numerical/qualitative distinction.
Coincident matter and object with different persistence conditions constitute an ontological problem. This is distinct from political Constitution Q7755; keep the shared alias multi-sense.
Only temporally present objects existing is an ontological thesis, distinct from retrospective present-day historical interpretation Q1842346.
Past and future objects existing is a rival temporal ontology, not presentism or time as a dimension.
Past-plus-present existence with an unreal future differs from both present-only and all-times ontologies.
Iterated tiny changes generating conflict for vague predicates define a specific paradox, not paradox in general.
Unknowable sharp boundaries are a particular theory of vagueness, not epistemology generally or a truth-value-gap solution.
Truth across admissible precisifications defines a semantic treatment distinct from epistemicism's unknown sharp boundary.
Conventional/ultimate truth distinctions in Indian Buddhist schools are a bounded philosophical topic, not truth generally or all Buddhist philosophy; preserve school differences.
The named butterfly-dream narrative is a specific thought experiment/story rather than a generic dream mechanism or all epistemology.
UK legislative supremacy is a constitutional doctrine, not the parliamentary institution or all constitutional rules.
Absence of one consolidated text differs from absence of written law; a structural constitutional category.
The specific 1911 statute and its historical limitation of veto are distinct from Parliament as an institution.
Manifesto-bill restraint is a specific constitutional convention, not the generic UK conventions set.
The distinct money-bill procedure is a supported application of the Parliament Acts, not the entire statute or Parliament.
Two legislative chambers define bicameral structure; the Commons-Lords example supports it, but UK procedural exceptions should not become universal claims.
The mixed-member proportional mechanism is a cross-country electoral-system type; New Zealand's named electoral system is an implementation rather than the same identity.
Two threshold routes in New Zealand's MMP system are a specific eligibility rule, distinct from the general mechanism and overhang seats.
Limited parliamentary support commitments differ from cabinet membership or forming a coalition.
Constitutionally unamendable principles differ from merely elevated amendment majorities; a specific German constitutional rule.
Conditional federal pre-emption of state legislation is a German implementation of concurrent powers, with a distinct legal mechanism rather than a renamed broad parent.
Ordinary standing requirements differ from Q7784740 Third-party standing, a specific exception. Keep the cited injury-causation-redressability test qualified as US federal law.
A nonparty contributing legal information differs from being a litigating party; a defined procedural role.
Criminal-law ambiguity construed favorably to the defendant is a particular interpretive rule, not criminal law generally.
Review of detention's legal basis is a specific remedial procedure, not general rule of law or a fresh guilt trial.
A doctrine of adhering to precedent differs from case law as decisions/principles constituting a source of law. Horizontal/vertical application supplies an independent takeaway.
Judgment without trial absent a material factual dispute is a specific procedural mechanism; retain the US federal Rule 56 framing.
Provisional relief before final decision and its required conditions are a bounded injunction subtype, not a generic stop order.
Final judgment preventing renewed litigation of a claim differs from preventing re-litigation of a necessarily determined issue.
Preclusion of an already decided issue differs from preclusion of an entire cause of action.
Regulator-supervised testing within legal requirements defines a policy instrument, not an unregulated software environment or a waiver of national law.
A particular US statute's federal-records access mechanism makes this a named legal work, distinct from administrative law as a field.
Releasing reasonably separable nonexempt portions is a specific disclosure duty within FOIA, not all FOIA access rights.
A particular statute governs covered collegial-agency meetings; distinct from FOIA's records regime.
Automatic legal expiry requiring renewal is a general statutory mechanism, not ordinary repeal or statutory law as a whole.
The specific post-apartheid commission and its separate mandates are distinct from apartheid as a system.
Full disclosure plus political-association conditions define a specific commission procedure, not the entire truth-and-reconciliation institution.
A named Supreme Court case and its public-education equal-protection holding are distinct from the broad equality-before-law principle.
A named Supreme Court case extending counsel protection in state felony trials is distinct from the criminal-law field.
A persisting object's incompatible time-indexed intrinsic properties raise a problem distinct from numerical/qualitative identity or coincident statue/clay constitution.
A supported reserve concerning what grounds coincident objects' different persistence conditions. Do not add to the 200 without comparing its intended card to material constitution.
